description: Generate a structured financial report as JSON. Supports P&L statement, KPI dashboard, and category breakdown report types.

date_from.description: Start date for multi-period reports (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM)

date_to.description: End date for multi-period reports (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM)

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.
